title: 回路电流方程的矩阵形式 B·Z·Bᵀ·I_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s
statement: 电路如图（V_s1 = 10 V，I_s5 = 1 A，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω，R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω，R_6 = 8 Ω）。画有向图时把 V_s1 与 R_1 的串联看成一条支路（支路 1），把 R_5 与 I_s5 的并联看成一条支路（支路 5），其余每个电阻一条支路；结点编号 1、2、3、4（4 接地），支路编号与方向见下方的有向图。
标准支路（复合支路）约定：支路 k 的电压 V_k、电流 I_k 取支路方向（关联），V_k = Z_k(I_k + I_sk) − V_sk；V_sk 的“+”极在支路终点一侧（推动电流沿支路方向流动）时为正，I_sk 的方向与支路方向**相反**时为正。
选树 T = {1, 2, 3}，以连支 4、5、6 的电流为回路电流 I_l（基本回路方向同连支方向），写出 Z_l·I_l = E_l，其中 Z_l = B_f·Z·B_fᵀ，E_l = B_f·V_s − B_f·Z·I_s，Z = diag(R_1, …, R_6)。

questions.explain: 回路 1、2 共有支路 1、2，在两个回路中方向都相同：+(2 + 4) = 6 Ω。
回路 2（连支 5）与回路 3（连支 6）共有支路 2、3，方向相反：−(4 + 4) = −8 Ω。

questions.ask: 右端 E_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s 的第 2 个元素 = ?
questions.explain: B·V_s：回路 2 含支路 1，V_s1 = 10 V → 10；B·Z·I_s：回路 2 含支路 5，Z_5·I_s5 = 2 × 1 = 2 → 10 − 2 = 8 V（I_s5 并 R_5 等效为与 R_5 串联、方向逆着支路的 2 V 电压源）。

questions.ask: 解出连支电流（回路电流）I_l1 = I_4 = ?

hints: 先写 B_f：每条连支一行。
Z_l 的对角元 = 回路自阻；非对角元 = 两回路共有支路的阻抗，两个回路在该支路上方向相同取正、相反取负。
右端：回路中电压源的电压（推动回路方向为正）减去电流源在其并联阻抗上产生的电压 Z_k·I_sk。

en.title: Loop equations in matrix form B·Z·Bᵀ·I_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s
statement: The circuit is drawn below (V_s1 = 10 V, I_s5 = 1 A, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω, R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω, R_6 = 8 Ω). In the graph, V_s1 in series with R_1 counts as one branch (branch 1), R_5 in parallel with I_s5 as one branch (branch 5), and each other resistor as one branch; the nodes are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 (4 is grounded) and the branch numbers and directions are those of the directed graph under the circuit.

Standard (composite) branch convention: V_k and I_k follow the branch direction (associated), V_k = Z_k(I_k + I_sk) − V_sk; V_sk is positive when its "+" is toward the end of the branch (it pushes current along the branch), and I_sk is positive when it points **against** the branch direction.

Choose the tree T = {1, 2, 3} and take the currents of links 4, 5, 6 as loop currents I_l (fundamental loops directed like their links). Write Z_l·I_l = E_l with Z_l = B_f·Z·B_fᵀ, E_l = B_f·V_s − B_f·Z·I_s, Z = diag(R_1, …, R_6).

questions.explain: Loops 1 and 2 share branches 1 and 2, both with the same direction in each: +(2 + 4) = 6 Ω.
Loops 2 (link 5) and 3 (link 6) share branches 2 and 3 with opposite directions: −(4 + 4) = −8 Ω.

questions.ask: Entry 2 of the right-hand side E_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s = ?
questions.explain: B·V_s: loop 2 contains branch 1 with V_s1 = 10 V → 10; B·Z·I_s: loop 2 contains branch 5 with Z_5·I_s5 = 2 × 1 = 2 → 10 − 2 = 8 V (I_s5 with R_5 is a 2 V source in series with R_5, acting against the branch).

questions.ask: Solve for the link (loop) current I_l1 = I_4 = ?

hints: Write B_f first: one row per link.
Diagonal of Z_l = loop self-impedance; off-diagonal = impedance of the branches two loops share, + when both loops run the same way through it, − otherwise.
Right-hand side: voltage sources in the loop (+ when pushing along the loop) minus the voltage Z_k·I_sk a current source makes across its parallel impedance.
solution: **Check:** same as the node method (previous problem): I_4 = V_n2/R_4 = 2.4/2 = 1.2 A ✓, I_2 = (6.8 − 2.4)/4 = 1.1 A ✓.
